Pseudo:
def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    required_symbols = set(case['required_symbols'])
    node_map = {n['id']: n for n in nodes}
    # build children
    children_map = {n['id']: [] for n in nodes}
    root = None
    for n in nodes:
        pid = n.get('parent')
        if pid is None:
            root = n['id']
        else:
            children_map[pid].append(n['id'])
    # compute subtree nodes recursively (post-order)
    subtree_nodes = {}  # id -> set of ids including self
    def compute_subtree(node_id):
        if node_id in subtree_nodes:
            return subtree_nodes[node_id]
        res = {node_id}
        for child in children_map.get(node_id, []):
            res |= compute_subtree(child)
        subtree_nodes[node_id] = res
        return res
    for n in nodes:
        compute_subtree(n['id'])
    # global symbol counts for required symbols
    total_req_count = {}
    for n in nodes:
        sym = n['symbol']
        if sym in required_symbols:
            total_req_count[sym] = total_req_count.get(sym,0)+1
    # initial retained set all
    retained = set(node_map.keys())
    removed_order = []
    # sort nodes: depth descending, then id ascending
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n['depth'], n['id']))
    for n in sorted_nodes:
        nid = n['id']
        if nid not in retained:
            continue
        if not n.get('removable', False):
            continue
        if n['symbol'] in required_symbols:
            continue
        # check children: any child still retained?
        if any(child in retained for child in children_map.get(nid,[])):
            continue
        # check required symbols: if removing this subtree removes all occurrences of a required symbol
        subtree = subtree_nodes[nid]
        # Count required symbols in subtree
        cnt_sub = {}
        for sid in subtree:
            sym = node_map[sid]['symbol']
            if sym in required_symbols:
                cnt_sub[sym] = cnt_sub.get(sym,0)+1
        # Check if any required symbol has all occurrences in subtree
        possible = True
        for sym, cnt_total in total_req_count.items():
            if cnt_sub.get(sym,0) >= cnt_total:  # if all occurrences are in subtree
                possible = False
                break
        if not possible:
            continue
        # remove node and its subtree from retained
        retained -= subtree
        removed_order.append(nid)
    # after loop, retained set contains all kept nodes
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    return {"removed_node_ids": removed_order, "retained_node_ids": retained_sorted}
